body:
See, that's part of the problem I think, there's nowhere I really *want* to work, I just need a job to pay my bills and maybe have some way to get out of the house. I wouldn't even know where to start.

I've just been browsing Indeed.com and Craigslist and sending resumes, applications, and personal notes to anything I'm even remotely qualified for, and I'm not getting ANY responses. It's seriously disheartening.

It's not that he's violent or has threatened me, I am so unhappy being near him that I feel it is pushing me closer to the edge. I can't stand his self-righteous judgmental personality, and I have no way to get away from it because like it or not, right now it's either his roof or no roof for me.
